steps.title: Prepare PCR Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a 6-reaction PCR mix by combining the following reagents:

substeps.instruction: Add 3.3 µL Q5 High-Fidelity DNA Polymerase (NEB #M0491S)

steps.title: Prepare PCR Tubes
steps.instruction: Add template and primers to the PCR tubes and aliquot the master mix.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µL of template DNA to each specified PCR tube
Add 0.5 µL of primer pairs to each specified PCR tube
Aliquot 48 µL of the prepared PCR mix into each tube

steps.title: Run Thermocycler Program
steps.instruction: Load the PCR tubes into the thermocycler and run the following program:

substeps.instruction: Initial annealing: desired annealing temperature for 30 seconds
Initial elongation: 72 °C for a duration depending on fragment length
Cycling (34 rounds): 98 °C for 10 seconds, followed by annealing and elongation (times/temps based on fragment length and primer annealing temperature)
